purpose: Entry point for all Grade 1-6 concept intelligence profiles.
resolver_rules: Resolve each concept ID in exactly one profile file.
Use the registry for representation and teaching-move IDs.
Every concept profile must point to at least one relevant curriculum/framework record; use curriculum_mapping_coverage.json to check research depth.
For China 2022 national-standard claims, apply cn_section_locators when a concept match exists and surface its section hierarchy as the evidence locator.
Do not display a China PDF page number when the locator record has printed_page=null.
Load diagnostic_extensions after base profiles and apply all link files before assembling diagnostics.
Diagnostic route coverage means at least one misconception/probe route is available; it does not imply that every misconception is empirically established.
Keep evidence status from the source record. Joining records does not increase confidence.
Use England when referring to the statutory National Curriculum in England.
Treat Common Core as a US comparison baseline, not a single US curriculum.
Do not use legacy PEP sequence as the current sequence.
Do not infer an exact China grade from a 2022 learning-stage requirement.
For mathematical practices, resolve cross-cutting framework aims rather than forcing a year-by-year placement.

copy_style.rule: Teacher-facing copy must be direct, instructional and specific.
